historical_transitions.summary: Frankencoin (ZCHF) core deployed at block 18451518; the constructor internally creates the Frankencoin Pool Shares (FPS) equity contract 0x1bA26788dfDe592fec64cbB0c7A3fbd9AE4c37F2, establishing the original share-governance control plane (2% holder veto via attack/bid/shoot).

Frankencoin Shares (FCS) deployed as non-proxy ERC-4626-style wrapper over FPS; the first FPS->FCS wrap (Wrapped event) executes 25 minutes later at block 25852635, migrating the share-governance control plane to FCS while the ZCHF core is untouched.

83 days post-deployment the FCS runtime bytecode at block 26450479 is byte-identical to the deployment-block output (both probes return 22904 hex chars, sha256 prefix 445d23e1c86f1303): no proxy upgrade and no admin controller. The block carries an ordinary wrap transaction, so migration continues under unchanged code.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: Pre-migration documentation presents Frankencoin Pool Shares (FPS) as the protocol's equity and governance token (26 FPS mentions) with zero references to FCS anywhere on docs.frankencoin.com.

Commit 'docs: add audited FCS mechanics and migration reference' adds fcs.md, fcs-migration.md and governance.md, making FCS the canonical share narrative - the repair event closing the post-launch documentation gap.
Post-repair snapshot: the docs index now references FCS / Frankencoin Shares extensively (53 mentions), confirming the migration documentation was publicly live by 2026-10-09.

gap_windows.summary: FCS governance wrapper live on-chain at block 25852506 while docs.frankencoin.com still documented only FPS (Wayback 2026-07-12). Gap closed by gitbook commit 2fe13b59aa at 2026-09-18T08:35:11Z (block 26003224). MTTR = 21 days.

Post-repair alignment window: documented FCS mechanics (non-proxy wrapper, 1:1 FPS wrap migration, 2% holder veto) match on-chain reality across blocks 26003224-26450479 - bytecode byte-identical at both endpoints, 50 Wrapped plus 34 Deposit events observed, zero Shot/veto events emitted.

executive_risk_memo: Frankencoin runs an oracle-free Swiss-franc CDP whose share-governance control plane migrated in August 2026: the new Frankencoin Shares (FCS) contract wraps legacy FPS pool shares in an ERC-4626-style vault while the ZCHF core deployed 2023-10-28 remains untouched. On-chain evidence shows FCS is non-proxy and byte-identical between deployment block 25852506 and checkpoint block 26450479, so no admin key or timelock can mutate the share ledger; governance power rests with the 2 percent holder veto, which has never been exercised since launch (zero Shot events across 50 Wrapped and 34 Deposit events). Documentation lagged deployment by 21 days (MTTR = 21): wrap mechanics were live on-chain before fcs.md existed, leaving integrators to read source during the gap. Engineering concentration is the dominant residual risk: 91 contract commits in 12 months but only 4 human contributors with a bus factor of 2 (luziusmeisser and samclassix author 96 percent of commits). With roughly $52.9M TVL, the posture is technically sound yet operationally fragile: monitor veto quorum participation, FPS residue, and documentation freshness rather than upgradeability.
